purpose: Test whether adding a second engine solid thermal-storage state creates any bounded M2 configuration that satisfies the already-consumed cold-start and hot-start evidence jointly before any M2 optimizer or blind prediction is permitted.

initialization.policy: Evaluate the full Cartesian product as fixed engineering sensitivity cases. Do not fit or select a hidden initial temperature continuously per run. A configuration is conditional if at least one preregistered initialization passes and robust only if every preregistered initialization passes.

stage_A_primary_structural_screen.evaluation_order_equivalence: Joint feasibility requires the identical global parameter configuration to pass both traces. Discarding cold failures before hot evaluation changes computation order only and preserves the exact joint feasible set.

classification.robust_joint_survivor: same global parameter configuration passes cold start and passes hot start under all 27 preregistered hidden-state initializations
classification.conditional_joint_survivor: same global parameter configuration passes cold start and passes hot start under at least one but not all preregistered hidden-state initializations
classification.non_survivor: fails cold start or fails hot start under every preregistered hidden-state initialization

stage_B_control_robustness_if_needed.opening_rule: Open only if Stage A has zero robust joint survivors. If Stage A has conditional-only survivors, Stage B may evaluate those exact conditional structural configurations for control robustness but blind execution remains blocked. If Stage A has zero conditional survivors, Stage B must cross the complete Stage A structural grid with the complete frozen control grid before M2 can be rejected.
stage_B_control_robustness_if_needed.interpretation_rule: A Stage B-only survivor demonstrates M2 family feasibility only under control-boundary uncertainty. It does not identify a topology parameter set and does not automatically authorize the blind rung.

numerics.vectorized_requirement: Every configuration must use the same frozen equations and parameter values. Scalar equivalence must be spot-checked before a final physical conclusion is frozen.

gate_interpretation.one_or_more_stage_A_robust_survivors: M2 is structurally viable at the central control boundary. Freeze a separate calibration/initialization/holdout protocol before any blind rung.
gate_interpretation.stage_A_conditional_only: M2 is viable only conditionally on hidden hot-start states. Do not open blind evidence until initialization treatment is independently constrained; execute the permitted Stage B robustness check if useful.
gate_interpretation.zero_stage_A_conditional_survivors: Execute complete Stage B exactly as preregistered before considering M2 rejection.
gate_interpretation.zero_stage_B_conditional_survivors: The governed M2 family is rejected on consumed development evidence and M3 dynamic-thermostat model-form planning may begin without opening the M2 blind reserve.
gate_interpretation.stage_B_only_survivors: M2 remains control-boundary-dependent. Do not report unique topology properties or open blind evidence without a separately frozen boundary/initialization protocol.
